ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: Case__r.RecordType_DeveloperName__c == 'Loan_Application' && ISPICKVAL(Case__r.Sub_Status__c, 'Discrepancy in documents') && ( ( ISCHANGED(cx_ln_Contact_Center_Result__c) && !ISBLANK(TEXT(cx_ln_Contact_Center_Result__c)) && !ISPICKVAL(cx_ln_Contact_Center_Result__c, 'Documents Uploaded') && !ISPICKVAL(cx_ln_Contact_Center_Result__c, 'Contact Failed') ) || ( ISCHANGED(cx_ln_Contact_Center_Result_sec__c) && !ISBLANK(TEXT(cx_ln_Contact_Center_Result_sec__c)) && !ISPICKVAL(cx_ln_Contact_Center_Result_sec__c, 'Documents Uploaded') && !ISPICKVAL(cx_ln_Contact_Center_Result_sec__c, 'Contact Failed') ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: For Sub Status “Discrepancy in documents”, the Contact Center Result can only be “Documents Uploaded” or “Contact Failed”. Please update your selection.
